description: A vampire's head and caped shoulders fill the lower half of the square, seen from the front. His skin is a ghastly pale cyan with deep blue shading in the cheeks, his hair dark blue and swept back, and his eyes glare red. A tall stiff collar rises behind his head, and a sweeping black cloak, picked out only by thin grey fold lines, spreads across the lower half. Behind him is a black night sky with a white crescent moon in the upper left and a flat grey strip of ground with a small grave cross on the right. The mood is cold, theatrical menace. Frame 1: the mouth is wide open in a snarl, red inside with long white fangs, held longest. Frame 2: the mouth closes to a tight grimace with fang tips showing. Frame 3: the lips close into a thin, cruel smile. Frame 4: the mouth begins to open again, brief. The loop reads as a slow cycle of snarling, closing into a smile and baring the fangs once more.
title: Vampire snarling under crescent moon
